system.description: As a bonus action, you can create a 10-foot radius bubble of water, centered on you. This bubble of water lasts for 10 minute or a hostile creature passes through the radius of the bubble. Sound cannot escape the inside of the bubble, nor penetrate to the inside of the bubble. Once used cannot be used again until you complete a short rest.
